title: Slop
summary: A Steam-like store for AI-made apps and games, on desktop and phone. Open source required, free to download, donation-funded, and voted Slop or Not Slop by people who've used them.
tryThis: Click ★ Interested on anything to see the sign-in screen, then sign in with any provider
Switch the title bar to Linux and add TidyFiles to your library - you'll be offered a community build
Switch to Android or iOS to see the phone app
Open Pixel Dungeon Delver → Reviews to see the vote history chart, then vote 👍 or 👎
Browse Coming soon & beta, including a dead project
Publish: make it Private Slop or a Coming soon game (with the Slop Pulse check), and plant a problem for the scanner
Library: open Grandma's Recipe Box and share it - official teams are locked out
Teams and Humans: join a team, then request a quote from a creative and vote on their work
